notices.description:
NYC AGING ID: K15
Older Adult Centers (OAC) provide an outlet aimed at socialization for community-dwelling older adults and prevent them from being isolated and disenfranchised. Older Adults engage in various programs and participate classes and activities including but not limited to art, music, dance, chronic disease self-management classes, nutrition workshops, benefits screenings, technology classes; recreational trips, transportation services; and congregate meals.

notices.short_title: FY27 Staten Island BSC NAE - Educational Data Systems Inc.
notices.description:
The NYC Department of Small Business Services is entering into a negotiated acquisition extension contract with Educational Data Systems Inc. to continue Business Solution Center services in Staten Island, to reinforce the City's efforts to support businesses of any size and at any stage, by responding to current and evolving needs while providing the conditions and resources to enable them to further grow and advance. The contract term will be from 7/1/2026 to 6/30/2027, in the amount of $291,414.00.

The negotiated acquisition extension will allow the agency adequate time to release a new solicitation for this program and enable the current BSC provider to continue to deliver a suite of business services white the Agency finalizes the RFP and award.

Vendors interested in responding to this or other future solicitations for these types of services should contact Kelly Taylor at Procurementhelpdesk@sbs.nyc.gov.
notices.plain: The Department of Small Business Services plans to extend its contract with Educational Data Systems Inc. for $291,414 to keep running the Staten Island Business Solution Center from July 1, 2026, through June 30, 2027, while it finishes a new solicitation for the program.

notices.short_title: Challenged Based Procurement - Venture Forward
notices.description: Although street vending provides critical services to millions and is a primary source of income for many New York City families, limited access to legal vending opportunities is a significant and long-standing challenge. Through the Challenge-Based Solicitation process, we are endeavoring to support the economic stability of street vendors who seek legal work, while balancing the needs of stakeholders that intersect with the street vending ecosystem. We are seeking program partners to identify and pilot immediately accessible interventions that: Create equitable tools to navigate the current street vending regulatory environment. Facilitate the expansion of existing opportunities and creation of new opportunities to support the economic stability of street vendors seeking legal work
notices.plain: The Department of Small Business Services awarded Urban Justice Center a $475,000 contract through a demonstration project to pilot interventions aimed at supporting the economic stability of street vendors seeking legal work.

Contract type: Contract

Contractor Address: 15375 Barranca Parkway, Suite I-112, Irvine, CA 92618

Scope of Services: SRV-8 Remotely Operated Vehicle Underwater Robot

E-PIN: 82626S0002001

How can I comment on this proposed contract award?
notable.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection is seeking public comment on a proposed sole-source contract with RJE Oceanbotics for an SRV-8 remotely operated underwater robot, with a maximum value of $166,730 over 365 consecutive calendar days.

notable.short_title: FY27 Queens East IBSP NAE - Chamber of Commerce Boro of Queens
notable.description:
This is a notice that the New York City Department of Small Business Services is seeking comments from the public about the proposed contract below. 

 

Contract Type: Contract 

Contractor: Chamber of Commerce Boro of Queens

Contractor Address: 75-20 Astoria Blvd., Suite 140, Jackson Heights, NY 11370

Scope of Services: This NAE for the NYC Industrial Business Solutions Program (IBSP) Chamber of Commerce Boro of Queens will reinforce the Citys efforts to support the industrial and manufacturing sector by responding to current and evolving needs while providing the conditions and resources to enable the sector to further grow and advance. Long Island City Partnership will deliver a suite of business services not limited to boro-wide technical consultant services, accessing incentive programs, providing information regarding City, State and Federal programs, financing and accessing capital, navigating government, and identifying employee and workforce services.

Maximum Value: $170,000.00

Term: 7/1/2026 to 6/30/2027

EPIN:
notable.plain: The Department of Small Business Services is seeking public comment on a proposed $170,000 negotiated contract with the Chamber of Commerce Boro of Queens to provide industrial business services in Queens from July 1, 2026, through June 30, 2027.
